title: 第20章 今晚必须拿下李大壮~~~
novel_title: 神医小傻驴的乡村女人
content_zh:
原本只能算是正常成色的葡萄，竟然迅速长大起来，颜色也变成了更诱人的紫，而且每一颗都散发着诱人的葡萄香味，那味道，比普通葡萄更浓烈，却又不会过于甜腻，反倒勾的人口水直流！

    眼看着每一粒葡萄都长成小鸡蛋那么大了，李大壮连忙停了手！

    “啥味？咋这么香甜？”张桂芬吸着鼻子回头一看，差点没从椅子上摔下来！

    “哎呦我滴个娘哎！咱家葡萄成精了！？”

    张桂芬看着那一颗颗圆润饱满，挂着露水，在清晨的阳光下散发着莹润水光，和勾人香气的大紫葡萄，简直惊呆了，当场摘了一颗，可一张嘴都塞不下，只能先咬了一口！

    葡萄极致的清新香甜，瞬间充斥了张桂芬的口腔，满满的汁液像是鲜榨葡萄汁一般丰盛，只一口，仿佛把她的灵魂都要吃出窍了~

    “大早晨叫唤啥？不就是个葡……”

    刚从屋里出来的李守义话还没说完就愣住了：“咱家葡萄咋这么多，这么大了！？”

    “爸，你尝尝，保证让你比老妈还激动！”

    李守义从闻见葡萄味就想吃了，这会儿更是忍不住连忙摘了一颗咬了一大口！

    “哎呦！这是葡萄还是仙果啊！我这辈子就没吃过这么好吃的东西！”

    李守义果然激动了！

    正好李秋霜也端着面条出来了，李大壮连忙摘了一颗葡萄喂给她吃，李秋霜惊讶的张开小嘴，只咬了一口，就享受的眯起了眼睛，她的嘴比张桂芬的还小，那满溢的葡萄汁几乎装不下，从小巧的唇角缓缓流出……

    “天呐！太美味了~~”

    “大壮，是你把咱家葡萄变成这样的对不对？肯定是你，你的本事这么大，这事儿除了你，没人能做到！”

    李秋霜一脸崇拜的看着李大壮，漂亮的眸子里仿佛盛满了小星星，闪着亮晶晶的光。

    “真的假的？”

    “大壮还有这本事！？”

    李守义和张桂芬都有些不敢置信。
content_en:
The grapes, which were originally only of normal color, grew up quickly and turned into a more attractive purple color. Moreover, each one exuded an alluring grape fragrance. The taste was stronger than ordinary grapes, but not too sweet. On the contrary, people with hooks were drooling!

    Seeing that each grape had grown into the size of a small egg, Li Dazhuang quickly stopped!

    "What does it smell like? Why is it so sweet?" Zhang Guifen sniffed and looked back, almost falling off the chair!

    "Ouch, what a bastard! Our grapes have become semen!?"

    Zhang Guifen was stunned when she looked at the big purple grapes that were round and full, hung with dew, exuding a moist luster in the early morning sun, and with a charming aroma. She picked one on the spot, but she couldn't fit it in her mouth, so she had to take a bite first!

    The ultimate freshness and sweetness of the grapes instantly filled Zhang Guifen's mouth. The full juice was as rich as freshly squeezed grape juice. With just one bite, it seemed as if her soul was being eaten out of her body~

    "Why are you calling so early in the morning? You're just a bastard..."

    Li Shouyi, who had just come out of the house, was stunned before he finished speaking: "Why are there so many grapes in our house, so big!?"

    "Dad, give it a try, I guarantee you will be more excited than mom!"

    Li Shouyi wanted to eat grapes since he smelled them, and now he couldn't help but pick one and took a big bite!

    "Ouch! Is this grapes or fairy fruit! I have never eaten anything so delicious in my life!"

    Li Shouyi was really excited!

    Just as Li Qiu Shuang came out with noodles, Li Dazhuang quickly picked a grape and fed it to her. Li Qiu Shuang opened her small mouth in surprise. She only took a bite and then narrowed her eyes in enjoyment. Her mouth was smaller than Zhang Guifen's. The overflowing grape juice could hardly be contained and slowly flowed out from the corners of her small lips...

    "Oh my god! It's so delicious~~"

    "Da Zhuang, it was you who turned our grapes into this, right? It must be you. You are so capable. No one can do this except you!"

    Li Qiu Shuang looked at Li Dazhuang with admiration, her beautiful eyes seemed to be filled with little stars, shining brightly.

    "Really or not?"

    "Da Zhuang still has this ability!?"

    Li Shouyi and Zhang Guifen were both in disbelief.
title_en: Chapter 20 Li Dazhuang must be captured tonight~~~
